parameters.name: Command
parameters.description:
The commands to run in the container. You can specify up to 20 commands. Each command can be up to 256 characters in length.\
The strings must be in the JSON format. Example: `["/bin/sh", "-c", "ls -a"]`.

parameters.name: ContainerGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the elastic container instance.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the instance.

parameters.name: Stdin
parameters.description: Specifies whether to read the commands from standard input (stdin). Default value: true.

parameters.name: Sync
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to immediately run the command and synchronously return the result. Default value: false.\
If this parameter is set to true, TTY must be set to false. Command cannot be set to `/bin/bash`.

parameters.name: TTY
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable interaction. Default value: false.\
If the Command parameter is set to `/bin/bash`, set this parameter to true.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun eci exec-container-command --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --container-group-id eci-2zebxkiifulhl0000 --container-name nginx --command /bin/sh_,_-c_,_ls_-a --tty false --stdin true --sync false --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun eci ExecContainerCommand --region cn-hangzhou --ContainerName nginx --Command '/bin/sh_,_-c_,_ls_-a' --TTY false --ContainerGroupId 'eci-2zebxkiifulhl0000' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --Sync false --Stdin true
